close_reason: Same-account guard added at task.rs:431-440 after destination account_exists and fromAccountId parse, matching the canonical jmap-mail-server email.rs:2263-2268 shape. Integration test copy_same_account_returns_invalid_arguments asserts the rejection. cargo fmt + clippy + test green.
description: RFC 8620 §5.4 mandates fromAccountId MUST differ from accountId. The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server enforces this in handle_email_copy at email.rs:2263-2268. tasks-server handle_task_copy at task.rs:418-505 has no equivalent check; a request with fromAccountId == accountId is silently accepted and produces a same-account duplicate. Fix: after parsing fromAccountId and before any backend round-trips, return JmapError::invalid_arguments("fromAccountId must be different from accountId") if the ids are equal. Add integration test that asserts the rejection.
title: tasks-server: Task/copy — reject same-account fromAccountId/accountId (RFC 8620 §5.4)
